facts.text: The Ritz-Carlton, Grand Cayman opened in 2005.
facts.excerpt: Opened in 2005 and expanded over the decades

facts.text: The resort sits directly on Seven Mile Beach.
facts.excerpt: Set right on Seven Mile Beach, the sprawling Ritz-Carlton property

facts.text: Rooms blend modern coastal elegance with mid-century British Caribbean style.
facts.excerpt: Blending modern coastal elegance with mid-century British Caribbean style

facts.text: Seven South is a combined 9-bedroom suite configuration that occupies an entire top-floor wing of the Ocean Tower.
facts.excerpt: Seven South occupies an entire top-floor wing of the resort’s Ocean Tower

facts.text: The Ritz-Carlton Suite can be expanded by connecting to an adjoining room with one double queen bedroom.
facts.excerpt: The suite can be expanded to add one double queen bedroom by connecting to an adjoining room

facts.text: Blue by Eric Ripert is an oceanfront seafood restaurant at the resort.
Silver Palm is a lounge with a rum selection, hand-picked cigars and live entertainment, and serves afternoon tea by day.
facts.excerpt: traditional afternoon tea. By night, feel the heart of the Caribbean in the lively lounge, which features one of the most exclusive Rum selections, hand-picked cigars

facts.text: The resort has six restaurants, including Seven (steakhouse), Taikun (sushi) and Andiamo Circolo Sportivo (Italian).
facts.excerpt: our six luxury Grand Cayman restaurants

facts.text: The Ritz-Carlton Spa offers treatments from ESPA and 111SKIN and has vibroacoustic wellness beds.
facts.excerpt: vibroacoustic wellness beds paired with immersive MyndStream soundscapes. Thoughtfully crafted rituals from ESPA and 111SKIN

facts.text: The Ritz-Carlton Golf Club has a nine-hole course designed by Greg Norman.
facts.excerpt: Designed by Greg Norman, the nine-hole course at The Ritz-Carlton Golf Club, Grand Cayman

facts.text: The resort has a tennis and pickleball complex with two courts that use TitanTrax surface.
facts.excerpt: Features five pickleball courts and four tennis courts including two hard courts and two with the innovative TitanTrax™ surface

facts.text: Families can join Jean-Michel Cousteau's Ambassadors of the Environment programs and the Starfish Cay Waterpark.
facts.excerpt: Starfish Cay Waterpark and Jean-Michel Cousteau's Ambassadors of the Environment program

facts.text: The Cayman Cookout is a culinary weekend hosted by Eric Ripert at the resort each January.
Cayman Cookout is held each January on Grand Cayman.
facts.excerpt: held each January on Grand Cayman

facts.text: Golf course routine maintenance takes place from June to October.
facts.excerpt: routine maintenance will take place June to October
